extraction_notes: The datasheet identifies MMBT4403 as a PNP transistor; signed PNP currents and voltages are preserved.
Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 contain usable DC curves. The points are compact manual digitizations of visible traces and are not interpolated.
The electrical table uses separate minimum and maximum columns. Duplicate entries preserve both bounds where the strict schema permits one value per field.
Cobo and Cibo have no tabulated numeric values. Fig. 6 is a plotted capacitance-versus-reverse-voltage graph, so the schema fields remain null rather than inventing a single-point value.
